name: Fiscal policy / deficit / government spending transmission contract

objectSeparation.BUDGET_PROJECTION: OMB/CBO or other forecast/baseline; expectation object, not realized cash flow
objectSeparation.TREASURY_CASH_FLOW: Daily/Monthly Treasury receipts, outlays, deficit and financing on Treasury reporting basis
objectSeparation.NIPA_GOVERNMENT_DEMAND: BEA government consumption expenditures and gross investment under national-accounts concepts
objectSeparation.FISCAL_IMPULSE: change in fiscal stance requiring an explicit methodology, baseline and cyclical-adjustment convention

coreMechanisms: Short-run aggregate-demand channel: changes in government purchases/transfers/taxes may alter private and public demand with timing/multiplier uncertainty.
Interest-rate/borrowing channel: additional federal borrowing may interact with Treasury supply, rates, term premia and private financing conditions.
Supply/incentive channel: taxes, transfers and public investment may alter labor, saving, productivity or private investment over longer horizons.
Composition matters: transfer payments, government consumption, infrastructure investment and tax changes do not share one multiplier or sector map.

TreasuryMTS.source: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Service Monthly Treasury Statement
TreasuryMTS.semantics: monthly receipts/outlays/surplus-deficit/means of financing on modified cash basis
TreasuryMTS.revisionGuard: preserve report vintage/publishedAt; later cumulative tables do not prove earlier availability

TreasuryDTS.semantics: daily cash/debt operations; cash-timing object, not NIPA GDP contribution
TreasuryDTS.use: liquidity/cash-flow context only after source clock/vintage is proven

BEA_NIPA.source: BEA National Income and Product Accounts
BEA_NIPA.semantics: government consumption expenditures and gross investment as final-demand/accounting concepts
BEA_NIPA.revisionGuard: NIPA estimates revise; current history is not guaranteed historical vintage

CBO_OMB.guard: forecast or scoring vintage must not be treated as realized fiscal flow

prohibitedShortcuts: government spending headline = BEA government GDP contribution
Treasury cash outlay = fiscal impulse without baseline/cyclical adjustment
one fiscal scalar score across sectors/horizons
falsification: separate forecast revisions from realized cash flows
composition interaction rather than total-deficit sign
test whether fiscal state adds beyond rates/USD/U.S.-equity demand
no outcome-selected fiscal window or multiplier assumption
